description: Org Self-Optimizer — external discovery pass (#830, org-optimizer-14; decision doc §6). A separate, less-frequent (weekly) run that scouts mcp-registry / npm / GitHub / web sources for a candidate MCP server or skill that fills a DETECTED audit gap, and writes an external-adoption proposal (always HIGH risk, always queued, never auto-applied). Composes existing discovery sources only — no bespoke crawler code.

hardExclusions: No install tool — approved candidates flow through the EXISTING curated-MCP install path (ensureCuratedMcps) or the skill-create path, invoked server-side only after a human approves the queued proposal.

Every suggestion must cite a concrete audit gap id (signal_ref) — 'trending/popular with no matching gap' is dropped by the generator, not by this scope, but this role grants no tool that could write a proposal bypassing that rule.
notes.cadence: Weekly (less frequent than the daily internal audit) — external search is expensive and noisy; results are capped per run and deduped against the already-suggested/rejected set.
